# 002 — A job scheduler starts the agents' work
**Date** 2026-10-03 · **Status** accepted, install pending (the founder approved the laptop — PENDING N9) · **Source** founder sent
a link to a free scheduler

**Context.** The shop needs helpers that start on a timetable, pick up tasks and stop at a spending cap.

**Decision.** Run the scheduler ourselves (open source, one small database) as the switchboard: who does what,
weekly goals, spending caps with hard stops, a yes/no step before anything goes out. No usage reporting; local network only.

**Not the scheduler's job.** Bookkeeping, ad budgets and stock counts.

**Consequences.** Lives on the shop laptop. Anything the scheduler cannot show gets a small page of its own.
